ONGC Starts Deepwater Drilling in Mahanadi Basin

State-owned Oil and Natural Gas Corporation (ONGC) has commenced deepwater exploratory drilling in the Mahanadi Basin. This marks the first such operation in the basin, aiming to tap into potential hydrocarbon reserves. The initiative is part of ONGC's broader strategy to enhance domestic oil and gas production. The drilling is being conducted using advanced technology to explore deep-sea resources.
